## You don't need money to change a life. You just need to show up.

At Megh Foundation, volunteers are not supporters - they are partners. Our Volunteering & Campaigns program channels the energy, skills, and passion of young professionals, students, and change-makers into meaningful on-ground action.

Through awareness campaigns, outreach drives, skill-sharing sessions, and community mobilization activities, our volunteers help awaken rural youth to their own potential, rights, and opportunities.

## Volunteer roles

- Training Volunteer - Teach skills to rural youth
- Career Mentor - Guide youth towards their right path
- Field Outreach Volunteer - Community visits and enrollment drives
- Content & Campaign Volunteer - Digital awareness and outreach
- Research & Impact Volunteer - Data collection and reporting

## Campaign focus areas

- Youth awareness and awakening drives
- Digital literacy awareness in rural communities
- Career rights and education access campaigns
- Community mobilization for enrollment in programs
- Social media campaigns amplifying youth voices

## What volunteers get

Internship, Certificate of Volunteering, LinkedIn Recommendation, Real NGO Experience, Changemaker Network, and Personal Growth.

## SDG alignment

SDG 4 - Quality Education  
SDG 10 - Reduced Inequalities  
SDG 16 - Strong Institutions  
SDG 17 - Partnerships for the Goals
